title: ㄴ·ㅁ·ㄹ·ㅇ으로 시작하는 글자 읽기
objective: Read and say ㄴ, ㅁ, ㄹ and ㅇ at the start of a syllable, including the quick ㄹ tap and the silent ㅇ, in simple words.
summary: Learn how ㄴ, ㅁ, ㄹ and ㅇ sound at the start of a syllable, then read easy words like 나무, 머리, 라면 and 우유.

task.title: READ AND CHOOSE
task.line: Read each Korean word out loud first, then choose or write the answer.

words.exampleMeaning: Do you want to eat ramyeon?

letters.sound: between vowels, a quick tap like the American "tt" in "butter" (not an English r); at the start of a word it is a light tap too
no sound: it only holds the place, so 아 sounds like "ah"
letters.as: silent at the start of a syllable (name: 이응)

exercises: Choose the word that means "milk": 우유 / 오이 / 우리
Write this word in romanization: 나무
Choose the word whose first letter makes no sound: 누나 / 모자 / 아이 / 라면
Choose the syllable that completes the word for "head": 머___ (리 / 니)
